verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms mParticle ships client SDKs that send event batches to a documented Events API (OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec and JSON reference). IDSync handles known and anonymous identities across apps and platforms, and the community confirms apps send data to mParticle. However, the pack never lists web, mobile, and server SDKs by platform, and never documents a tracking spec with track/identify/page semantics. Server-side collection is evidenced only as a raw HTTP API with codegen-able helper SDKs, not official server SDKs. missing for 10: explicit official web, iOS/Android and server SDK documentation, a documented track/identify/page-style tracking spec, hands-on corroboration of multi-platform collection.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can collect events from web, mobile, and server apps through official SDKs that implement a documented tracking spec (track, identify, page)
